description: Mozambique satellite detected waters, Cyclone Idai is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP - World Food Programme. This dataset is a compilation of various sources such as Copernicus, Sentinel-1 and Atmospheric and Environmental Research, A Verisk Business, & African Risk Capacity using several days to calculate the maximum flood extent for the whole event. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher WFP - World Food Programme. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-12-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
